standard.title: Python Patch Version Naming
standard.summary: Python patched distributions retain upstream names and use canonical local versions on a controlled index, with explicit resolver and release-identity evidence.
standard.fitness-role: Experimental Python profile; not an approved gate

requirements.override-explanation: Specializes the parent naming outcome with PEP 440 local versions and controlled-index resolution while preserving upstream baseline and OSERA identity; SemVer build-metadata spelling is not imposed on Python.
requirements.text: Patched distributions must retain the normalized upstream distribution name and use the canonical version <baseline>+osera.<N>, where baseline is a supported canonical public final version and N is a positive unpadded integer, with supported-tool evidence that the intended remediation is selected.

checks.override-explanation: Replaces generic profile-selection evidence with canonical Python syntax, baseline identity, ordering and supported-tool resolution evidence; the parent recipient outcome remains required.
checks.title: Python version preserves the baseline and resolves to the intended remediation

requirements.override-explanation: Specializes identifier consistency for Python distribution metadata and package URLs while retaining source-tag, artifact, feed and evidence correlation.
requirements.text: Release tags, distribution filenames and metadata, Python package URLs, feeds and release evidence must identify the same canonical patched release; repository origin and file SHA-256 must distinguish its individual artifacts.

checks.override-explanation: Checks Python name normalization and version identity across source, distributions and feeds; repository and digest evidence supplement rather than replace the parent consistency rule.
checks.title: Python release identity is consistent across source, distributions and feeds

requirements.text: The release counter must increase without reuse for each normalized distribution and exact baseline, and each later patch must retain all prior remediation fixes on that baseline.

checks.title: Counter allocation is unique and remediation fixes are cumulative
